Also found and FIXED additional bug: POST /api/country-visits 'upgrade' path was not saving share_diary field.

bugs_fixed.issue: POST /api/country-visits 'upgrade' path was not saving share_diary field
bugs_fixed.fix: Added share_diary to the $set update in the existing_visit block (line 84)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The update for existing visits was missing the share_diary field in the MongoDB $set operation

share_diary_not_saved_on_upgrade.description: When a user POSTs to /api/country-visits for a country they already visited (upgrade path), the share_diary field was not being saved
share_diary_not_saved_on_upgrade.root_cause: In country_visits.py create_country_visit(), the existing_visit update block (lines 79-89) did not include share_diary in the $set operation, even though it was included for new visits (line 136)
share_diary_not_saved_on_upgrade.fix_applied: Added 'share_diary': getattr(data, 'share_diary', True) to the $set operation in the upgrade block
share_diary_not_saved_on_upgrade.verification: Tested POST with share_diary=false on existing visit, then GET confirmed share_diary=False is returned
